typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchivePath as string (),
	DBPassword as string (),
	DBServerName as string (),
	EmailRecipients as string (),
	ErrorEmailRecipients as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	File_Exists_DB as integer (),
	File_Exists_Fl as string (),
	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportPath as string (),
	InitialCatalog as string (),
	NoFileEmailRecipients as string (),
	RecordsInSrcFile as integer (),
	TableName as string (),
	UserName as string (),
	startTime as string ()
}

source(output(
		EDL_LOAD_DTM as string,
		EDL_RUN_ID as string,
		EDL_SCRTY_LVL_CD as string,
		EDL_LOB_CD as string,
		EDL_EXTRNL_LOAD_CD as string,
		EDL_SOR_CD as string,
		INCRD_YEAR_MNTH_NBR as string,
		RPT_MDL_NM as string,
		MCID as string,
		LOB_PARTN_ID as string,
		DSPLY_OPT_CD as string,
		MDL_CI3_KEY as string,
		MNGBL_CNDTN_IND as string,
		LIPA_CTGRY_SCOR_NBR as string,
		CI3_SCOR_NBR as string,
		CI3_GRP_NM as string,
		CI3_RANK_NBR as string,
		OBSTY_FLAG_NBR as string,
		FEEDG_ASSTNT_FLAG_NBR as string,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(File_Name_Output = right($ImportFile, locate('\\', reverse($ImportFile), 1) - 1),
		File_Load_Datetime = $startTime) ~> DeriveFileNameColumm
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCountAGGREGATE
DeriveFileNameColumm sink(input(
		EDL_RUN_ID as string,
		FEEDG_ASSTNT_FLAG_NBR as integer,
		CI3_RANK_NBR as integer,
		FILE_LOAD_DTM as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FILE_NAME as string,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		DSPLY_OPT_CD as string,
		EDL_SCRTY_LVL_CD as string,
		OBSTY_FLAG_NBR as integer,
		RPT_MDL_NM as string,
		MNGBL_CNDTN_IND as string,
		CI3_GRP_NM as string,
		INCRD_YEAR_MNTH_NBR as integer,
		MCID as integer,
		LOB_PARTN_ID as integer,
		EDL_LOAD_DTM as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		EDL_LOB_CD as string,
		EDL_SOR_CD as string,
		MDL_CI3_KEY as string,
		CI3_SCOR_NBR as integer,
		EDL_EXTRNL_LOAD_CD as string,
		LIPA_CTGRY_SCOR_NBR as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		EDL_RUN_ID,
		FEEDG_ASSTNT_FLAG_NBR,
		CI3_RANK_NBR,
		FILE_LOAD_DTM = File_Load_Datetime,
		FILE_NAME = File_Name_Output,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID,
		DSPLY_OPT_CD,
		EDL_SCRTY_LVL_CD,
		OBSTY_FLAG_NBR,
		RPT_MDL_NM,
		MNGBL_CNDTN_IND,
		CI3_GRP_NM,
		INCRD_YEAR_MNTH_NBR,
		MCID,
		LOB_PARTN_ID,
		EDL_LOAD_DTM,
		EDL_LOB_CD,
		EDL_SOR_CD,
		MDL_CI3_KEY,
		CI3_SCOR_NBR,
		EDL_EXTRNL_LOAD_CD,
		LIPA_CTGRY_SCOR_NBR)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCountAGGREGATE sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
